description: Frozen protocol for the Lattigo v2 calibration and compiled-corpus evaluation.
holdout_rule: Sort the complete BENCHMARKS list in the runner and assign every fourth benchmark (1-based positions divisible by 4) to holdout before measurements. Partial runs retain the same assignments.

measurements.rss_metric: median of per-run /usr/bin/time peak RSS in MiB

acceptance_gates.heldout_budget_false_reject_rate: <= 0.10 among programs whose measured median RSS fits the budget

model_v2.baseline_source: Rounded median RSS from four empty-worker (N,L) microbench pairs.
model_v2.lattigo_parameter_tables: (nQ+nP)*2*N*8 bytes for the resident forward/backward NTT tables.
model_v2.helper_buffers: Source-derived CKKS evaluator, encryptor, decryptor, basis-extender, and encoder buffers; one N-word automorphism index per Galois key; input and output harness scratch.
model_v2.gc_headroom_factor_source: Development-only 95th percentile of (median RSS - estimated baseline - estimated managed live - estimated input plaintext transient)/(estimated managed live) across 74 successful programs measured at GOGC=100; linear interpolation.
model_v2.hi: baseline + managed_live + input_plaintext_transient + managed_live*gc_headroom_factor; development-calibrated estimate, not a physical RSS bound.

tuning_policy: Diagnose and calibrate only on development. The GC/RSS headroom factor is selected from the development residual distribution and evaluated by leave-one-benchmark-out on development. Do not tune against holdout. Freeze and commit v2 before running the holdout, then score the holdout once; the historic aggregate holdout result was seen earlier and must be disclosed.
ast_roots: All variables assigned to encryptedOutputs are combined under a non-allocating Vec root so the estimate covers every output retained by the generated program.
scope: The corpus has 108 planned candidates: all regular benchmarks at widths 4, 8, and 16; dot_product, hamming_dist, and l2_distance additionally at width 32; Conv2D compiler-native at requested widths <= 16; and three Deep Network circuit modes at their listed parameters. CryptoNets is excluded because it is not enabled in the root build; polynomials_coyote emits SEAL code rather than Lattigo. DCT, max, polynomial-derivative, and sort compiler modes may fail generation or parsing and such failures are recorded rather than counted as measurements.
